name: Pixel painting
description: Paint a picture with both handles: Me paints after "draw" until "stop", It reads colours. Colours by voice, "recognize" turns outlines into rails; level 2 lets It trace a colour, level 3 has a finer grid, level 4 recognizes freehand shapes.

levels.name: Canvas
levels.intro: Canvas. Say draw to paint with Me, stop to lift the pen.

levels.name: Trace
levels.intro: Trace. Say draw and stop to paint, show red to feel it.

levels.name: Fine canvas
Feelable shapes
levels.intro: Feelable shapes. Say start drawing, draw with Me, then say stop drawing.
